task: Create a polished report design review page with frozen synthetic data, readable findings and evidence, and complete/incomplete/failure examples.
nonGoals: Backend or scoring changes, real audits, modifying shared API contracts, paid services, merging or replacing the production preview.

outcomes.description: A dedicated /report-design page presents product context, score breakdown, priority actions, evidence and human-readable checks using the approved visual style.
outcomes.evidence: Desktop and mobile browser inspection with synthetic-data disclosure.

outcomes.description: Frozen complete, incomplete, zero-coverage and retrieval-failure states demonstrate honest scores, explanatory copy and accessible interaction.
outcomes.evidence: Registered preview runtime tests and exact expected score/coverage assertions.

outcomes.description: The user can review the design at a distinct Cloudflare Free Pages preview URL.
outcomes.evidence: Reviewed source, hosted CI, branch preview deployment and public browser verification.

process.description: Plan first, use Terra implementation and independent review, keep backend ownership and current live preview separate.
process.evidence: Git history, source-bound evaluation and review.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing rubric and sample data without adding dependencies, expose clear language before technical detail, and keep layout responsive.

exitTest.reason: A synthetic frontend review page does not alter workflow, portability, memory or handoff mechanisms.
